title: Team 16 Intent Grammar (FROZEN v1.0)
description: Frozen at ST-1, 07 August 2026. Five constraint types, three on_violation actions, one 1-5 priority scale. Adding a constraint type after ST-3 requires whole-team sign-off and is rejected by default (see docs/decisions.md, ADR-002).

priority.description: 1 = highest, 5 = best effort. Drives preemption in M2. Ties resolved by admission order: first admitted keeps its resources.

guarantee.description: THE FIVE FROZEN CONSTRAINT TYPES. Do not add a sixth.

min_bandwidth_mbps.description: Constraint 1. Guaranteed rate, enforced by an OVS HTB queue in M4.

max_latency_ms.description: Constraint 2. One-way delay ceiling, measured by active probe in M5.

max_loss_pct.description: Constraint 3. Loss ceiling as a percentage, derived from counter deltas in M5.

isolate_from.description: Constraint 4. Tenants this intent must not share a path with. Enforced by disjoint-path selection in M3.

avoid_links.description: Constraint 5. Links this intent must never traverse, e.g. s3-s4. Pruned before path selection in M3.

consistency.description: strict -> two-phase versioned update (lossless, roughly doubles flow-table use during switch-over). relaxed -> direct install (cheap, drops packets in flight). Operator-declared.

on_violation.description: THE THREE FROZEN ACTIONS. reroute: recompute and reinstall. degrade: reduce the guarantee rather than move. alert_only: log and raise, take no action.

dwell_seconds.description: Anti-oscillation hold-off. Minimum time before this intent may be re-planned again. Tunable so the oscillation graph (metric E6) can be produced with damping on and off.

cidr.description: IPv4 address with prefix length, e.g. 10.0.0.1/32.

link.description: Undirected switch-to-switch link identifier, e.g. s3-s4. Canonical form is lower-numbered switch first.
